purpose: External quality baseline for the ocrx scan pipeline ahead of the v2 inference-platform refactor; leaderboard submission is out of scope.

benchmark.name: OmniDocBench
benchmark.dataset_license: research use only, not for commercial use
benchmark.eval_docker_image_note: pulled via ghcr.nju.edu.cn mirror (ghcr.io blob CDN unreachable from this network); runtime verified with script/verify_repro_runtime.sh

pdf_wrapping.mediabox_rule: page points = pixels * 72 / 300 (300 DPI PDFium render reproduces source pixel grid)
pdf_wrapping.oversized_note: PDFium downscales proportionally to the 2880x2880 budget; per-page ratio in scans/<profile>/<doc>/page-0001.render-audit

scan.command_template: ocrx scan pdfs -o scans/<profile> --model ovisocr2 --model-profile <profile> --dpi 300 --non-interactive --progress off --log-level warn

transforms: strip leaked <think>...</think> reasoning blocks (known ocrx defect, counted in export-report.json)

splits.note: en_ch_mixed/traditional_chinese/other (131 pages) excluded from splits, included in all

reproduce.dataset_download: HF_ENDPOINT=https://hf-mirror.com hf download opendatalab/OmniDocBench --repo-type dataset --revision aa1ee96d106dbe53d0ae59474d75c6e6d9b53fec --local-dir dataset --include "OmniDocBench.json" "with_mask.json" "images/*"
